clips.title: The story
paras: Camp Taurajo holds the eastern mouth of the pass into Mulgore. The tauren camp offers travelers an inn, supplies, mentors, and wind rider routes across the plains and central Kalimdor.

At Camp Taurajo, you reach the eastern mouth of the pass into Mulgore. For young tauren leaving Bloodhoof Village, the camp is often their first glimpse of the wider Barrens. Dry scrubland and rugged mesas surround this outpost and trading hub. Hunters, leathercrafters, and field herbalists find shelter here, while wind riders connect the camp to Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and Freewind Post deeper south.
